name: AureaProvider
summary: Root provider: strings, icon sprite, text direction, toasts and where popups mount.

a11y.apg: No pattern and no role: the provider renders no element of its own, it only carries context. What it does carry matters for accessibility — the strings behind every built-in accessible name, and portalContainer, which decides whether popup content lands inside one of your landmarks.

props.name: children
props.description: Your application. Put the provider once, at the root — everything below it reads the context.

props.name: strings
props.description: Overrides for the built-in accessible names and labels. Merged over the defaults, so you translate only what you need. `ptBR` ships as a ready locale.

props.name: spriteUrl
props.description: Where the Carbon sprite lives. Application configuration, so it belongs here and not on every Icon — an app served from a sub-path used to lose every glyph and had to be fixed component by component.

props.name: direction
props.description: Tells the engine which way the inline axis runs, so popup sides and arrow keys mirror. The CSS mirrors on its own through logical properties — but you still have to put dir="rtl" on your <html>; the provider does not touch the DOM.

props.name: portalContainer
props.description: Where every popup mounts: dialog, drawer, tooltip, popover, hover card, both menus, notification panel, combobox list and toasts. Unset, they mount on document.body — which is what lets them stack and position without inheriting overflow or transform from anything. Point it at a node inside one of your landmarks when you need popup content to satisfy the "all content in a landmark" check.

props.name: theme
props.description: Controlled theme. Pass it to command; the provider then never writes it on its own.

props.name: defaultTheme
props.description: Seeds the theme without controlling it. With NEITHER of the two, the provider adopts whatever the document already carries on <html> — the data-theme in the markup exists so the page does not flash, and a provider that overwrote it on first paint would bring the flash back.

props.name: onThemeChange
props.description: Fires with the new theme, whether it changed from here or from useTheme.

props.name: density
props.description: Controlled density. Same convention as theme.

props.name: defaultDensity
props.description: Seeds the density without controlling it.
